profile.name: Nikhil Venkataraman
profile.subline: Transportation and structural engineering roles for a May 2027 MS graduate who needs visa sponsorship · Tailored to your resume · Board re-mapped to Phoenix
profile.recentRole: Phoenix engineering consultancy — Transportation Engineering Intern (Summer 2026)
profile.stack: AutoCAD Civil 3D, transportation modelling, Python for traffic data, structural analysis, EIT
profile.target: Transportation or structural engineer · Phoenix, AZ · needs H-1B sponsorship
profile.summary: A civil engineer on a software board: the researched employers are a mismatch, and several of their programs state no visa sponsorship, which rules them out twice over. The suggested Phoenix engineering consultancies and public agencies are the list, and your two years of practice before the master's count as experience.
profile.applyNow: The large consultancies (Kimley-Horn, HDR, AECOM) sponsor engineers routinely; apply to their Phoenix EIT postings first.
profile.watchLater: ADOT and the City of Phoenix post engineer-in-training roles but rarely sponsor.
